instruction: Look for Batman action figures for boys and sort by lowest price.

metadata.explanation: Variation 2: Similar to original - toy category with character theme (Batman instead of Spider-Man), for boys instead of kids, sorted by price low-to-high. Maintains same complexity and interaction pattern.
